text:
باہر میاں پنج ہزاری،
اندر بیبی قہر دی ماری۔
romanized:
Bāhar mīā̃ panj-hazārī,
Andar bībī kahr dī mārī.
literal_en:
Outside a gentleman worth five thousand rupees,
inside his lady stricken with poverty.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
